verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs say every review appends a generated summary to the PR description, grouped by change type, and posts a structured walkthrough comment at the top of the PR thread. Reviews run automatically within moments of a PR being opened, configurable via reviews.auto_review, so every PR gets this orientation material without manual steps. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the summaries and walkthroughs help reviewers orient.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast

citations.quote: CodeRabbit appends a generated summary to the bottom of the PR description after a review. The summary groups changes by type
Every time CodeRabbit reviews a pull request, it posts a **walkthrough comment** — a structured overview of the changes that appears at the top of the PR comment thread
Within moments of opening a pull request, CodeRabbit analyzes your code with multiple AI models and provides actionable feedback
Configure when and how CodeRabbit automatically reviews pull requests using the `reviews.auto_review` settings.
